subject.title: Bug: write tool and exec heredocs insert literal \n instead of newlines in string content

question: Should parser/runtime owners sponsor a repair of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95982 now, or coordinate it with the adjacent Windows-path heuristic PR first?
rationale: The remaining issue is not whether the bug exists; it is how maintainers want the shared parser heuristic repaired without regressing Windows-path compatibility across provider tool-call parsing.

options.title: Repair the linked PR now
options.body: Ask the PR author or a maintainer to fix the predicate blockers, add proof, and keep this issue open until that PR or an equivalent patch merges.

options.title: Coordinate both parser PRs
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95982 together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96748 so the two heuristic changes land as one coherent parser contract.

options.title: Pause the PR path
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the open PR until a parser owner writes the desired compatibility rule explicitly.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR now
recommendation.body: Ask the PR author or a maintainer to fix the predicate blockers, add proof, and keep this issue open until that PR or an equivalent patch merges.

likelyOwner.reason: The central Windows-path heuristic entered main through the merged parser work associated with this owner history, and the remaining choice is parser/runtime contract direction.
